degree_required.quote: at least one hundred fifty (150) semester hours of college education, including a baccalaureate or higher degree conferred by a college or university acceptable to the board, the total educational program to include an accounting concentration or equivalent as determined by board rule to be appropriate

required.quote: An applicant for initial issuance of a certificate under this section shall show that the applicant has had one (1) year of experience.

experience_source.quote: An applicant for initial issuance of a certificate under this section shall show that the applicant has had one (1) year of experience. This experience shall include providing any type of service or advice involving the use of accounting, attest, management advisory, financial advisory, tax or consulting skills, all of which were verified by a licensee.

duration.quote: the applicant has had one (1) year of experience

kind.value: accounting, attest, management advisory, financial advisory, tax or consulting skills, verified by a licensee
kind.quote: providing any type of service or advice involving the use of accounting, attest, management advisory, financial advisory, tax or consulting skills, all of which were verified by a licensee

exams.name: Uniform Certified Public Accountant Examination
exams.notes: The board may use all or any part of the AICPA Uniform CPA Examination and Advisory Grading Service; exam must be passed as a condition for granting a certificate.
exams.quote: The board may make such use of all or any part of the Uniform Certified Public Accountant Examination and Advisory Grading Service of the AICPA

interval_years.quote: Certificates shall be initially issued and renewed for periods of no more than two (2) years. Every holder of a certificate as a certified public accountant or a registration as a public accountant shall be required to renew the certificate or registration biennially.

required.quote: The requirements established by the board shall prescribe regulations requiring continuing education of eighty (80) credit hours over a two-year period, with a minimum of twenty (20) credit hours in each year as a prerequisite for the renewal of a certificate.

hours_per_period.quote: continuing education of eighty (80) credit hours over a two-year period

period_years.quote: eighty (80) credit hours over a two-year period

available.quote: An individual whose principal place of business is not in this state having a valid license as a certified public accountant from any state that the board or its designee has verified to be in substantial equivalence with the CPA licensure requirements of this chapter shall be presumed to have qualifications substantially equivalent to this state's requirements and shall have all the privileges of licensees of this state without the need to obtain a certificate or permit

requirements.value: Out-of-state CPAs from substantially equivalent states receive practice privileges with no notice or submission required. Those from non-verified states must obtain individual verification of substantial equivalency. All must consent to board jurisdiction, comply with TN law, cease practice if home license lapses, and appoint home-state board as agent for service of process.
requirements.quote: An individual licensee of another state exercising the privilege afforded under this section and the CPA firm that employs the licensee, as a condition of the grant of this privilege, simultaneously consent to the following: To the personal and subject matter jurisdiction and disciplinary authority of the board; To comply with this chapter and the board's rules

exists.quote: "Board" means the state board of accountancy established under § 62-1-104 or its predecessor under prior law

title_protection.quote: No person not holding a valid certificate shall use or assume the title "certified public accountant" or the abbreviation "CPA" or any other title, designation, words, letters, abbreviation, sign, card or device tending to indicate that the person is a certified public accountant.

scope_protection.quote: Only licensees may issue a report on financial statements of any other person, firm, organization or governmental unit or otherwise offer to render or render any attest service.

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud or deceit in obtaining a license

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Cancellation, revocation, suspension or refusal to renew a license or practice rights for disciplinary reasons in any other state for any cause

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain compliance with requirements for issuance or renewal of the license or to report changes to the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure on the part of a licensee to maintain compliance with the requirements for issuance or renewal of the license or to report changes to the board under § 62-1-107(f) or § 62-1-108(g)

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation or suspension of the right to practice before any state or federal agency
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Revocation or suspension of the right to practice before any state or federal agency

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dishonesty, fraud or gross negligence in the performance of services or in filing income tax returns
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dishonesty, fraud or gross negligence in the performance of services as a licensee or in the filing or failure to file the licensee's own income tax returns

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provision of this chapter or rule promulgated by the board or violation of professional standards
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any provision of this chapter or rule promulgated by the board under this chapter or violation of professional standards

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any rule of professional conduct promulgated by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any rule of professional conduct promulgated by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or any crime involving dishonesty or fraud
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony or of any crime an element of which is dishonesty or fraud under the laws of the United States, of this state, or of any other state or country if the acts involved would have constituted a crime under the laws of this state.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performance of any fraudulent act while holding a certificate or permit
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performance of any fraudulent act while holding a certificate or permit issued under this chapter or prior law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any conduct reflecting adversely upon the licensee's fitness to perform services while a licensee
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any conduct reflecting adversely upon the licensee's fitness to perform services while a licensee

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making any false or misleading statement or verification in support of an application for a license filed by another

establishment_regulation_required.quote: A firm with multiple locations shall obtain a permit for each location. A firm must hold a permit issued under this section in order to provide attest services

definition_quote.value: Only licensees may issue a report on financial statements of any other person, firm, organization or governmental unit or otherwise offer to render or render any attest service. This restriction does not prohibit any act of a public official or public employee in the performance of that person's duties as such, or prohibit the performance by any person of other services involving the use of accounting skills, including the preparation of tax returns, management advisory services and the preparation of financial statements without the issuance of reports thereon.
definition_quote.quote: Only licensees may issue a report on financial statements of any other person, firm, organization or governmental unit or otherwise offer to render or render any attest service. This restriction does not prohibit any act of a public official or public employee in the performance of that person's duties as such, or prohibit the performance by any person of other services involving the use of accounting skills, including the preparation of tax returns, management advisory services and the preparation of financial statements without the issuance of reports thereon.

value: issuance of reports on financial statements

compilation_services_authorized.quote: The issuance of any report, including compilation reports, prescribed by the SASs, the SSARSs or the SSAEs on any services to which those statements on standards apply

education_semester_hours_required.quote: at least one hundred fifty (150) semester hours of college education

practice_privilege_no_notice_required.quote: Notwithstanding any other law, an individual who offers or renders professional services under this section, whether in person, by mail, telephone or electronic means, shall be granted practice privileges in this state; and no notice or other submission shall be provided by the individual.

value: consent to personal and subject matter jurisdiction and disciplinary authority of the board
comply with this chapter and the board's rules
cease offering or rendering professional services in this state if home-state license is no longer valid
appointment of the state board that issued the license as agent upon whom process may be served
practice_privilege_consent_conditions.quote: An individual licensee of another state exercising the privilege afforded under this section and the CPA firm that employs the licensee, as a condition of the grant of this privilege, simultaneously consent to the following: To the personal and subject matter jurisdiction and disciplinary authority of the board; To comply with this chapter and the board's rules; That in the event the license from the state of the individual's principal place of business is no longer valid, the individual shall cease offering or rendering professional services in this state individually and on behalf of a CPA firm; and To the appointment of the state board that issued the license as the agent upon whom process may be served

attest_services_require_firm_permit.quote: The holder of a certificate issued under this section may only provide attest services in a CPA firm that holds a permit issued under § 62-1-108.

firm_majority_cpa_ownership_required.quote: a simple majority of the beneficial ownership of the firm, in terms of financial interests in the equity capital and voting rights held by all partners, officers, shareholders, members or managers, belongs to holders of a certificate who are licensed in some state

nonlicensee_firm_owners_permitted.quote: Any CPA firm may include nonlicensee owners

peer_review_required_for_firm_renewal.quote: The board shall require, by rule, as a condition to renewal of permits under this section, that applicants enroll in a board approved peer review program and undergo at least once every three (3) years, peer reviews conducted in the manner that the board specifies.

peer_review_max_frequency_years.quote: undergo at least once every three (3) years, peer reviews conducted in the manner that the board specifies

peer_review_records_privileged.quote: that the peer review processes be operated, and documents maintained, in a manner designed to preserve confidentiality under §§ 62-1-116 and 62-1-202 and that no third party, other than the board or the board's designee, shall have access to documents furnished or generated in the course of the peer review

inactive_license_status_available.quote: The board may by rule create an exception to this requirement for certificate holders who do not perform or offer to perform for the public one (1) or more kinds of services involving the use of accounting or auditing skills... Licensees granted such an exception by the board must place the word "inactive" adjacent to their CPA title or PA title

office_supervision_by_licensed_cpa_requi.quote: all attest services rendered in this state are under the charge of a person holding a valid certificate issued under § 62-1-107 or the corresponding provision of prior law or some other state law

attest_report_signer_competency_requirem.quote: Any individual licensee who is responsible for supervising attest services and signs or authorizes someone to sign the accountants' report on the financial statements on behalf of the firm shall meet the experience requirements set out in the professional standards for those services

client_confidentiality_privilege.quote: Licensees shall not divulge, nor shall they in any manner be required to divulge, any information that is communicated to them or obtained by them by the reason of the confidential nature of their employment.

working_papers_ownership_by_licensee.quote: all statements, records, schedules, working papers and memoranda incident to or in the course of rendering services to a client, made by a licensee or a partner, shareholder, officer, director, member, manager or employee of a licensee... shall be and remain the property of the licensee in the absence of an express agreement between the licensee and the client to the contrary.

commission_prohibition_during_attest.quote: A licensee shall neither pay any consideration or commission to obtain a client nor accept any consideration or commission for the referral of a client to others when the licensee or the licensee's firm also performs for that client any of the following: An audit or review of a financial statement; A compilation of a financial statement when the licensee expects, or reasonably might expect, that a third party will use the financial statement and the licensee's compilation does not disclose a lack of independence; or An examination of prospective financial information.

contingent_fee_prohibition_during_attest.quote: A licensee shall not receive or agree to receive a contingent fee from a client for the following: Performance of any professional services for a client for whom the licensee or person associated with the licensee performs any of the following: An audit or review of a financial statement; A compilation of a financial statement... or An examination of prospective financial information; or Preparation of an original tax return.

safe_harbor_disclaimer_language_for_nonl.quote: Nonlicensees may not use language in any statement relating to the financial affairs of a person or entity that is conventionally used by licensees in reports on financial statements. In this regard, the board shall issue rules providing safe harbor language that nonlicensees may use in connection with the financial information.

foreign_accountant_practice_exception.quote: None of the provisions of subsections (a)-(i) shall have any application to a person or firm holding a certification, designation, degree or license granted in a foreign country entitling the holder of a certification, designation, degree or license granted in a foreign country to engage in the practice of accountancy or its equivalent in that country, whose activities in this state are limited to the provision of professional services to persons or firms who are residents of, governments of or business entities of the country in which the person holds such entitlement, who performs no attest services

firm_corrective_action_period_for_owners.quote: Firms that fall out of compliance with the section due to changes in firm ownership or personnel after receiving or renewing a permit shall take corrective action to bring the firm back into compliance. The board may grant a reasonable period of time for a firm to take corrective action.

firm_permit_required_for_attest_services.quote: A firm must hold a permit issued under this section in order to provide attest services or to use the title "CPAs," "CPA firm," "PAs" or "PA firm."

client_records_return_obligation.quote: A licensee shall furnish to a client or former client, upon request and reasonable notice: A copy of the licensee's working papers, to the extent that the working papers include records that would ordinarily constitute part of the client's records and are not otherwise available to the client; and Any accounting or other records belonging to or obtained from or on behalf of the client that the licensee removed from the client's premises or received for the client's account.
